title: Telangana High Court directs action over proposed Ambedkar book release
description: The Telangana High Court directed authorities to take action according to law over the proposed release of Kalpitha Nayakudu – The Fabricated Leader – Volume 1 on B R Ambedkar. The Government informed the Court that author Hamara Prasad was arrested and copies seized.

title: Erravalli farmers oppose survey near K Chandrashekhar Rao’s agricultural lands
description: Farmers in Erravally village of Siddipet district opposed a revenue survey near K Chandrashekhar Rao’s agricultural lands on Thursday. They said more than 150 farmers had cultivated 388 acres of assigned land for decades and expressed apprehension that the government might take back the land.

title: Telangana inaugurates State Climate Centre for Cities, launches Urban Climate Atlas
description: Telangana launched the State Climate Centre for Cities to strengthen climate-responsive urban planning across Urban Local Bodies. The Centre will support climate-risk assessments, action plans and budgeting, while the Telangana Urban Climate Atlas will help officials map vulnerabilities and prioritise investments.

title: Telangana allows adult family members to attend SIR electoral roll hearings
description: Telangana has allowed adult family members to attend Special Intensive Revision electoral roll hearings on behalf of voters and submit necessary documents. CEO C Sudharsan Reddy directed officials to accept such documents and resolve notices, while ensuring compliance with ECI rules.

title: India thrashes Afghanistan by 127 runs to complete 3-0 T20I series sweep
description: India thrashed Afghanistan by 127 runs to complete a 3-0 T20I series sweep in New Delhi. Abhishek Sharma smashed a record 30-ball hundred, while Nitish Kumar Reddy and Ravi Bishnoi took three wickets each as Afghanistan were bowled out for 94.

title: Hyderabad: 21-year-old woman, father crushed to death by tipper lorry
description: A 21-year-old woman and her father were crushed to death by a tipper lorry at Aramghar crossroads in Hyderabad on Wednesday night. The victims, residents of Attapur, were reportedly attending to wedding-related work when the accident occurred, police said.

title: హత్య కేసును ఛేదిందిన చిలకలగూడ పోలీసులు
description: కుమారుడి ఆర్థిక లావాదేవి వివాదంలో తండ్రిని హత్య చేసిన నిందితుడిని చిలకలగూడ పోలీసులు అరెస్ట్‌ చేశారు. పోలీసుల వివరాల ప్రకారం.. సీతాఫల్‌మండికి చెందిన సుమన్‌కు భోలక్‌పూర్‌కు చెందిన మహ్మద్‌ నిజాముద్దిన్‌ (36)తో పరిచయం ఏర్పడింది. ఈక్రమంలో షేర్‌ మార్కెట్‌ ట్రేడింగ్‌, పెట్టుబడుల పేరుతో సుమన్‌ దాదాపు రూ. 50 లక్షల నుంచి 60 లక్షల వరకు నిజాముద్దిన్‌ వద్ద తీసుకున్నాడు.

title: రిటైర్మెంట్‌ బెనిఫిట్స్‌ కోసం లక్ష లంచం
description: రిటైర్మెంట్‌ బెనిఫిట్స్‌ కోసం లంచం తీసుకుంటూ చేవెళ్ల ఏటీవో అనురాధ, ఎస్‌టీవో లక్ష్మయ్య మధ్యవర్తి జం గయ్య ఏసీబీకి చిక్కారు. రంగారెడ్డి జిల్లా ఏసీ బీ డీఎస్పీ అనంద్‌కుమార్‌ తెలిపిన వివరాల ప్రకారం .. నాలుగేండ్ల క్రితం ఉద్యోగ విరమ ణ పొందిన ఓ పంచాయతీ కార్యదర్శికి రిటైర్మెంట్‌ బెనిఫిట్స్‌ రూ.23 లక్షలు రావాల్సి ఉ న్నది. బిల్లులు ఇప్పించాలని అతడు చేవెళ్ల సబ్‌ ట్రెజరరీ కార్యాలయ ఏటీవో, ఎస్‌టీవోను కోరాడు.

title: US mortgage rates brush 7%, weighing on buyers, sellers and further straining a bleak housing market
description: US mortgage rates have climbed close to 7%, putting further pressure on an already sluggish housing market. The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate rose to 6.95%, its highest level since January 2025. Higher borrowing costs are squeezing affordability, delaying purchases and raising concerns about a further slowdown in home sales.

The move could bring crypto platforms deeper into traditional equity markets, allowing potential 24/7 trading, instant settlement and fractional ownership, while maintaining issuer consent and investor protection requirements.

title: Fed builds credibility, but hawkish turn leaves investors edgy
description: In a significant move, the Federal Reserve has raised interest rates for the first time since 2023, marking a shift towards a hawkish stance on inflation management. This unanimous choice has led investors to brace for more potential rate increases, generating ripple effects across asset markets. Following a surge, bond yields have retracted. Yet, the future trajectory of the Fed's monetary policy remains uncertain.
